grh_e13d3bef4dd6bfb3a8bc.title: The Desert Song
paragraphs: Pierre, the French governor's seemingly idle son, secretly leads oppressed desert tribes as the masked Red Shadow. Margot is drawn both to Pierre and to the daring outlaw without knowing they are the same man, while Pierre's own father is determined to destroy the Red Shadow. grh_e17c4d808340b356f82f.title: Still Time to Die
paragraphs: A dramatization of correspondent Jack Belden's Still Time to Die rejects sanitized or triumphalist descriptions of modern war. Recovering from wounds, Belden recalls the hunger, bombing, fear and misery he witnessed from Malta to the battlefields of Europe and contrasts those realities with confident commentary heard far from combat. Returning to the United States, he warns that prejudice, reaction and authoritarian thinking can exist at home as well as abroad, and concludes that military victory must be joined to a continuing fight for genuine democratic freedom.
